reason: The hypothesis makes multiple specific claims about interdiffusion, elemental depletion, and their effect on wear-corrosion in eutectic HEAs, but cites no prior evidence to support any of these premises.
premises: Slow cooling creates broad interdiffusion zones at phase boundaries in multi-phase eutectic HEAs
Interdiffusion zones are locally depleted in corrosion-resistant elements
Wear exposes these depleted zones, accelerating corrosion
Rapid cooling suppresses interdiffusion, preserving corrosion-resistant elements at boundaries
Preserved boundaries reduce coupled wear-corrosion degradation at high temperature
